senses.gloss: m. (קָלַח) spouting forth, continuous flow, jet.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 36a:2">Ḥull. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>דם ק׳</he> the blood which comes forth in a jet (in blood-letting); <cite ref="Keritot 22a:50">Ker. 22ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:12">Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>להערות עם הק׳</he> to pour (boiling water) from vessel to vessel in a jet (instead of in short spurts); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:5:3">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ</cite> <he>לערות מן הק׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:7">T’bul Yom. II, 7</cite>. Y. B. Bath. III, end, 14ᵇ <he>מקום קִילּוּחוֹ בחצר</he> the place where the water gushes forth (from the spout) in the neighbor’s court; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:13">Tosef. ib. II, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:8:4">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="N00946"><he>נָסַךְ</he></cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="S01304"><he>קֶלַח</he></cite>.
